build_document_from_upload: build a Mistral-format document dict with base64 data URI from uploaded file bytes
parse_multipart_form: parse multipart form data from an OCR request and extract file, model, and other parameters
parse_ocr_request: parse an OCR request supporting both JSON body and multipart form data input modes
run_ocr_endpoint: run the OCR endpoint to extract text from documents and images via JSON or file upload
build_fastapi_router: build a FastAPI router with OCR endpoints at /v1/ocr and /ocr requiring user API key auth
